title: Virtual try-on fails gracefully
user_visible_behavior: When the photo is invalid, the provider times out or the provider errors, the shopper sees a clear message and can retry, and browsing and adding to cart remain unaffected.
verification: Scenario 1 — an invalid photo is rejected before any provider call: `lib/try-on/photo-validation.test.ts` 8 tests cover the empty/unsupported/4 MiB/signature rules ('rejects an empty file...', 'rejects unsupported and missing MIME types before the size check', 'accepts exactly 4 MiB (inclusive boundary)...', 'rejects one byte over 4 MiB...', 'recognises PNG, JPEG and WebP magic bytes', 'rejects a spoofed text file, truncated headers and empty input'). `app/api/try-on/route.test.ts` 'returns 400 invalid_photo for an empty photo before any catalog or provider call (scenario 1)', 'returns 400 invalid_photo for a non-image declared type before any catalog or provider call (scenario 1)' and 'rejects a spoofed extension whose bytes are not PNG/JPEG/WebP before any catalog or provider call (scenario 1)' all assert code `invalid_photo` and that `getTryOnGarmentContext`/`getTryOnProvider` were never called. The panel rejects an unsupported type locally before fetch and disables the action ('rejects an unsupported declared type before any request (scenario 1)'), and a server `invalid_photo` clears the selection ('clears the selection when the server rejects the photo and never enables a retry (scenario 1)').

Scenario 2 — an oversized photo is rejected before any provider call and exactly 4 MiB passes: `lib/try-on/photo-validation.test.ts` 'rejects one byte over 4 MiB with the size-limit message' and 'accepts exactly 4 MiB (inclusive boundary) for every allowed type'; route 'returns 400 invalid_photo for an oversized photo before any catalog or provider call (scenario 2)' and 'accepts exactly 4 MiB (inclusive boundary) and calls the provider (scenario 2)'; panel 'rejects a photo larger than 4 MiB, clears it, and sends no request (scenario 2)' and 'accepts exactly 4 MiB (inclusive boundary) (scenario 2)'.

Scenario 3 — a provider timeout surfaces a clear failure and retry affordance: `lib/try-on/openai-images-try-on-provider.test.ts` 'passes a timeout-bounded AbortSignal to fetch and defaults the bound to 30 s', 'aborts fetch after timeoutMs and throws a timeout error with fixed copy', 'maps an aborted fetch (TimeoutError/AbortError) to the timeout kind' and 'maps an abort while reading the response body to the timeout kind'; route 'returns 504 provider_timeout with no-store and no provider text (scenario 3)'; panel 'shows timeout-specific copy and a "Try again" action without a partial result (scenario 3)'.

Scenario 4 — a provider error surfaces clear copy, keeps the in-memory input and retries the same photo to success: route 'returns 502 provider_error without forwarding the provider message (scenario 4)' and 'returns 502 provider_error for an unexpected thrown error without leaking it'; panel 'keeps the photo, size, color and consent and retries the same photo after a provider error (scenario 4)' (asserts the second FormData carries the identical File object, same size/color/consent, then a single successful result and no failure line) and 'maps a network failure to clear copy and allows a retry'.

Scenario 5 — the rest of the product page keeps working after a try-on failure: `app/products/[slug]/page.test.tsx` 'scenario 5: keeps the rest of the product page working after a try-on failure' renders the real page, fails the panel through a stubbed 502, asserts the single `role="alert"` failure line, then confirms the heading, $349.00 price, all three gallery thumbnails, size guide, variant stock message, catalog link, thumbnail swap and variant selection all still respond, and the panel remains retryable.
